# Overview

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
| | |
|---|---|
| **Project** | Leptin treatment and its effect on hypothalamic brain regions |
| **Lab** | Friedman Lab — Rockefeller University |
| **Analyst** | Matt Paul (Figs 4B–C); other panels — see individual section notes |
| **Analysis** | Functional validation of Otp as a STAT3 target required for leptin-mediated inhibition of AgRP/LepR neurons (ARC cluster 0) |

**Key finding:** Despite shared STAT3 activation across LepR neuron subtypes, the homeobox transcription factor Otp is selectively induced in AgRP/LepR neurons. Disruption of Otp abolishes leptin-mediated inhibition of AgRP neuron firing and increases food intake and body weight.
:::

# Fig 4B — Chromatin accessibility at the Otp locus in AgRP/LepR neurons

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Genome browser–style coverage tracks showing per-condition snATAC-seq accessibility at the Otp locus in ARC cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons). Tracks include per-condition ATAC coverage (OB, Lep3h, Lep27h, Lep75h, WT), the linked cis-regulatory element (CRE), STAT3 motif position, and the peak-to-gene link arc. Generated using Signac `CoveragePlot`.

**Normalisation note:** Signac normalises coverage tracks by **reads per million (RPM)** — Tn5 insertion counts are divided by the total fragments in each condition group and scaled to 10⁶. This corrects for sequencing depth but not for unequal cell numbers across conditions. A second tab shows a **cell-downsampled** version where each condition is randomly subsampled to the same number of cells before plotting, making track heights directly comparable on a per-cell basis.
:::

## Data loading

```{r, fig4B.data.load, eval=T}

seu_atac <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ATAC"
seu_atac[["tech"]] <- "ATAC"

# Update fragment path if needed
seu_atac@assays$ATAC@fragments[[1]]@path <- "../Data.Objects/frags/fragments.tsv.gz"

ARC <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/final_ARC_merged_clusters_20250206.rds")

# Match ATAC cells to ARC cluster assignments
names_arc  <- names(ARC$cluster)
names_atac <- names(seu_atac$orig.ident)
seu_atac$keep <- names_atac %in% names_arc
seu_atac_sub  <- subset(seu_atac, keep)
seu_atac_sub$cluster <- ARC$cluster[match(names(seu_atac_sub$orig.ident), names_arc)]

# Subset to cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons)
seu_atac_c0 <- subset(seu_atac_sub, cluster == "0")

# ── Recreate Fragment object after subsetting ─────────────────────────────────
# Directly setting @path leaves the @cells slot stale; CreateFragmentObject
# rebuilds it correctly so CoveragePlot can index cells against the fragment file
frag_path <- "../Data.Objects/frags/fragments.tsv.gz"
frags_c0  <- CreateFragmentObject(path = frag_path, cells = colnames(seu_atac_c0))
Fragments(seu_atac_c0) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_atac_c0) <- frags_c0
```

```{r}
# ── STAT3 eRegulon peaks overlapping the Otp window ──────────────────────────
library(rtracklayer, quietly = TRUE)
library(stringr,     quietly = TRUE)

ereg <- rtracklayer::import("../Data.Objects/scenic_plus_res2/arc/eRegulons.bed")
tf   <- str_split(ereg$name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
stat3_regions <- ereg[tf %in% "Stat3"]

# Will be intersected with the plot window once otp_region is defined below
cat("Total STAT3 eRegulon peaks:", length(stat3_regions), "\n")


```

## Coverage track — Otp locus

```{r, fig4B.Otp.shared, eval=T}

# ── Shared setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otp_region <- "chr13-94850000-94950000"

seu_atac_c0$condition_clean <- dplyr::recode(seu_atac_c0$group,
  "ob"         = "OB",
  "Leptin3hr"  = "Lep3h",
  "Leptin24hr" = "Lep27h",
  "Leptin72hr" = "Lep75h",
  "wt"         = "WT"
)
seu_atac_c0$condition_clean <- factor(
  seu_atac_c0$condition_clean,
  levels = c("OB", "Lep3h", "Lep27h", "Lep75h", "WT")
)

otp_gr       <- StringToGRanges(otp_region)
stat3_in_otp <- subsetByOverlaps(stat3_regions, otp_gr)
x_min <- start(otp_gr)
x_max <- end(otp_gr)

has_links      <- length(Links(seu_atac_c0))      > 0
has_annotation <- length(Annotation(seu_atac_c0)) > 0

# ── Helper: append STAT3 block track to a CoveragePlot ───────────────────────
add_stat3_track <- function(p) {
  if (length(stat3_in_otp) == 0) return(p)
  stat3_df    <- as.data.frame(stat3_in_otp)
  stat3_track <- ggplot(stat3_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
              fill = "#c0392b", color = NA) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    ylab("STAT3\nregulon")
  p / stat3_track + plot_layout(heights = c(10, 0.5))
}

# ── Cell counts per condition (for downsampling) ──────────────────────────────
cells_per_cond <- table(seu_atac_c0$condition_clean)
n_downsample   <- min(cells_per_cond)
cat("Cells per condition:\n"); print(cells_per_cond)
cat("Downsampling to:", n_downsample, "cells per condition\n")

set.seed(rand_seed)
cells_ds <- unlist(lapply(levels(seu_atac_c0$condition_clean), function(cond) {
  conds_cells <- colnames(seu_atac_c0)[seu_atac_c0$condition_clean == cond]
  sample(conds_cells, min(n_downsample, length(conds_cells)))
}))
seu_atac_c0_ds <- subset(seu_atac_c0, cells = cells_ds)

# Recreate fragment object for the downsampled subset
frags_ds <- CreateFragmentObject(path = frag_path, cells = colnames(seu_atac_c0_ds))
Fragments(seu_atac_c0_ds) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_atac_c0_ds) <- frags_ds

```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### RPM normalised

```{r, fig4B.Otp.coverage.rpm, fig.height=8, fig.width=14, eval=T}

p_rpm <- CoveragePlot(
  object     = seu_atac_c0,
  region     = otp_region,
  group.by   = "condition_clean",
  annotation = has_annotation,
  peaks      = TRUE,
  links      = has_links
) &
  scale_fill_manual(values = arc_cond_colors)

print(add_stat3_track(p_rpm))

```

### Cell-downsampled (equal cells per condition)

```{r, fig4B.Otp.coverage.ds, fig.height=8, fig.width=14, eval=T}

p_ds <- CoveragePlot(
  object     = seu_atac_c0_ds,
  region     = otp_region,
  group.by   = "condition_clean",
  annotation = has_annotation,
  peaks      = TRUE,
  links      = has_links
) &
  scale_fill_manual(values = arc_cond_colors)

print(add_stat3_track(p_ds))

```

# Fig 4C — STAT3 motif accessibility at the Otp-linked CRE

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Aggregate Tn5 insertion enrichment (footprint metaplot) centered on STAT3 motif sites in ARC cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons), restricted to the **3 STAT3 eRegulon peaks within 20 kb of the Otp locus**. One line per condition shows the dynamic accessibility profile across the leptin time course. Generated using Signac `Footprint` + a custom smoothed plot function.
:::

## Motif annotation and footprinting

```{r, fig4C.data.prep, eval=T}

library(JASPAR2022, quietly = TRUE)
library(TFBSTools, quietly = TRUE)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, quietly = TRUE)
library(motifmatchr, quietly = TRUE)

pwm_stat3 <- getMatrixSet(x = JASPAR2022, opts = list(ID = "MA0144.1"))

# ── Define Otp ± 20 kb window ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
otp_20kb        <- otp_gr
start(otp_20kb) <- max(1, start(otp_20kb) - 20000)
end(otp_20kb)   <- end(otp_20kb) + 20000
cat("Otp ± 20 kb window:", as.character(otp_20kb), "\n")

# ── Combined object: clusters 0, 3, 17 ───────────────────────────────────────
# Footprint() needs all three clusters together to sample all 4096 hexamers —
# small individual cluster subsets fail InsertionBias with the hexamer error.
# Cluster filtering is done at plot time via cluster__condition grouping instead.
seu_c0_3_17 <- subset(seu_atac_sub, cluster %in% c("0", "3", "17"))

frags_combined <- CreateFragmentObject(path = frag_path, cells = colnames(seu_c0_3_17))
Fragments(seu_c0_3_17) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_c0_3_17) <- frags_combined

# Subset to Otp ± 20 kb peaks
peaks_win  <- subsetByOverlaps(granges(seu_c0_3_17), otp_20kb)
peak_names <- GRangesToString(peaks_win)
cat("ATAC peaks within Otp ± 20 kb:", length(peak_names), "\n")

seu_c0_3_17_otp <- seu_c0_3_17[peak_names, ]

frags_otp <- CreateFragmentObject(path = frag_path, cells = colnames(seu_c0_3_17_otp))
Fragments(seu_c0_3_17_otp) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_c0_3_17_otp) <- frags_otp

# AddMotifs + Footprint on combined object
ARC_motif_combined <- AddMotifs(object = seu_c0_3_17_otp,
                                genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10,
                                pfm    = pwm_stat3)

ARC_motif_combined <- Footprint(object     = ARC_motif_combined,
                                motif.name = "MA0144.1",
                                genome     = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10,
                                in.peaks   = FALSE)

```

## Footprint metaplot

```{r, fig4C.STAT3.footprint, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, eval=T}

library(slider, quietly = TRUE)

# Custom smoothed footprint plot (adapted from Figure 3F)
# Uses .before=7, .after=7 sliding mean and restricts to abs(position) < 101
custom_footprint_plot3 <- function(object, features, group.by = NULL,
                                    cluster.use = NULL, cluster.col = "cluster",
                                    normalization = "subtract") {
  library(magrittr); library(dplyr); library(slider); library(ggplot2)

  # Build cluster__condition grouping when filtering to a specific cluster
  if (!is.null(cluster.use)) {
    object$fp_group <- paste(object[[cluster.col]][, 1],
                             object[[group.by]][, 1], sep = "__")
    fp_group.by <- "fp_group"
  } else {
    fp_group.by <- group.by
  }

  assay     <- Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = object)
  plot.data <- GetFootprintData(object = object, features = features,
                                assay = assay, group.by = fp_group.by)
  if (!is.data.frame(plot.data)) plot.data <- do.call(rbind, plot.data)
  plot.data %<>% dplyr::filter(abs(position) <= 200)

  # Keep all Expected rows; filter Observed rows to the requested cluster only
  if (!is.null(cluster.use)) {
    prefix <- paste0(cluster.use, "__")
    keep   <- (plot.data$class == "Observed" & grepl(paste0("^", prefix), plot.data$group)) |
               plot.data$class == "Expected"
    plot.data <- plot.data[keep, ]
    plot.data$group <- sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", plot.data$group)
  }

  motif.sizes <- Signac:::GetMotifSize(object = object, features = features, assay = assay)
  obs    <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Observed", ]
  expect <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Expected", ]
  base   <- ceiling(motif.sizes / 2)

  obs$flanks <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(obs)), function(x) {
    pos  <- abs(obs[x, "position"])
    size <- base[[obs[x, "feature"]]]
    (pos > size) & (pos < (size + 50))
  })

  if (!is.null(normalization)) {
    correction.vec <- setNames(expect$norm.value, paste(expect$position, expect$feature))
    obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value - correction.vec[paste(obs$position, obs$feature)]
  }

  # Recode raw object condition labels to display labels
  obs$group <- dplyr::recode(obs$group,
    "Leptin3hr"  = "Lep3h",
    "Leptin24hr" = "Lep27h",
    "Leptin72hr" = "Lep75h",
    "Leptin27hr" = "Lep27h",
    "Leptin75hr" = "Lep75h",
    "ob"         = "OB",
    "wt"         = "WT"
  )

  i <- 1
  df <- obs[obs$feature == features[[i]], ]

  final_mat <- lapply(unique(df$group), function(grp) {
    df_temp <- df %>%
      filter(group == grp) %>%
      group_by(position) %>%
      summarise(mean_norm = mean(norm.value), .groups = "drop")
    df_temp$mean_norm_slide <- slide_dbl(df_temp$mean_norm, mean, .before = 7, .after = 7)
    df_temp$group <- grp
    dplyr::filter(df_temp, abs(position) < 101)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, final_mat)

  axis.min <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[1] - diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10
  axis.max <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[2] + diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10

  ggplot(df, aes(x = position, y = mean_norm_slide, color = group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = arc_cond_colors_raw) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("Distance from motif (bp)") +
    ylab("Tn5 insertion enrichment") +
    ggtitle("STAT3 motif accessibility at Otp-linked CRE\n(ARC cluster 0, AgRP/LepR neurons)") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(axis.min, axis.max)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1)))
}

```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r, fig4C.c0.footprint, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, eval=T}
custom_footprint_plot3(ARC_motif_combined, features = "MA0144.1",
                       group.by = "group", cluster.use = "0") +
  ggtitle("STAT3 motif accessibility — Otp ± 20 kb\nCluster 0 (AgRP / LepR neurons)")
```

```{r, fig4C.combined.footprint, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, eval=T}

# grouped only by condition to give one line per condition
custom_footprint_plot3(ARC_motif_combined, features = "MA0144.1",
                       group.by = "group") +
  ggtitle("STAT3 motif accessibility — Otp ± 20 kb\nClusters 0, 3 and 17 pooled (LepR neurons)")
```
